options.content: Choose players, modes and a date range. Game statistics cover **rated standard chess** from August 2026 onward. Current account ratings are shown separately and can include games after the competition. Missing accuracy is excluded from averages; sample counts show coverage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS time, rating AS value, name || ' / ' || mode AS metric
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Current account ratings
panels.description: Latest /stats observation; independent of the dashboard date range and prize leaderboard.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name || ' / ' || mode AS "Player / mode", rating AS "Current rating"
          FROM dashboard.current_ratings WHERE username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring})
          ORDER BY mode, rating DESC

SELECT name || ' / ' || mode AS "Player / mode",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'win') AS "Wins",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'draw') AS "Draws",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'loss') AS "Losses",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'unknown') AS "Unknown"
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY name, mode ORDER BY name, mode

SELECT date_trunc('day', ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg')
          AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg' AS time, count(*) AS value, name || ' / ' || mode AS metric
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Win rate by colour
panels.description: Wins divided by all games played with that colour. No games produces a missing value, not zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name || ' / ' || mode AS "Player / mode",
          100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE colour = 'white' AND outcome = 'win') /
              nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE colour = 'white'), 0) AS "White",
          100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE colour = 'black' AND outcome = 'win') /
              nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE colour = 'black'), 0) AS "Black"
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY name, mode ORDER BY name, mode

panels.title: Average opponent rating
panels.description: Opponent ratings as recorded after each game.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name || ' / ' || mode AS "Player / mode",
          avg(opponent_rating) AS "Opponent rating"
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY name, mode ORDER BY name, mode

panels.title: Average accuracy
panels.description: Labels show games with accuracy / total games. Missing accuracy is excluded from averages.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name || ' / ' || mode || ' (' || count(accuracy) || '/' || count(*) || ')' AS "Player / coverage",
          avg(accuracy) AS "Accuracy"
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY name, mode ORDER BY name, mode

panels.title: Club head-to-head
panels.description: Each matchup is shown from each selected player's perspective. Do not sum mirrored rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name || ' vs ' || opponent || ' / ' || mode AS "Matchup",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'win') AS "Wins",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'draw') AS "Draws",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'loss') AS "Losses",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'unknown') AS "Unknown"
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
          AND opponent IN (SELECT username FROM dashboard.players)
          GROUP BY name, opponent, mode ORDER BY name, opponent, mode

SELECT name AS "Player", mode AS "Mode", rating AS "Current rating",
          last_game_at AS "Last rated game", observed_at AS "Fetched" FROM dashboard.current_ratings
          WHERE username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) ORDER BY mode, rating DESC

SELECT name AS "Player", mode AS "Mode",
          round(avg(accuracy)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg accuracy %",
          count(accuracy) AS "Games with accuracy", count(*) AS "Total games"
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY name, mode ORDER BY name, mode

SELECT name AS "Player", mode AS "Mode", colour AS "Colour",
          count(*) AS "Games", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'win') / count(*), 1) AS "Win %"
          FROM dashboard.games WHERE rated AND rules = 'chess' AND username IN (${player:sqlstring})
AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY name, mode, colour ORDER BY name, mode, colour
SELECT name, status, last_success_at FROM dashboard.sync_status ORDER BY name

list.label: Players
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, username AS __value FROM dashboard.players ORDER BY name
